_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT
_note: Metabolic batch. Orchestrator assumption: scientist-d is a fourth equivalent Scientist under the shared contract roles/scientist.md (body 32); operator authorised up to four Scientists on 2026-10-19.
OBJECTIVE: Read, in tier order, the studies of blood transfusion and plasma products (groups H1 and H2) listed in disease-models/wwox/research/interventions_batch_selection_20261019.md, asking what each implies for WWOX loss of function. Most groups have NO WWOX-deficient evidence: state it plainly, label every substitute as not WWOX evidence, class-level only, BLOCK-1 caution, not medical advice.

SCOPE.lot: groups H1 of the interventions selection file; HELD-partial only with a stated question; BLOCKED excluded

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: per paper: manifest PASS, receipt JSON staged under research/receipt_staging, locators verbatim
DEFAULTS_TAKEN and STOP_LOG in this JSON
DELIVERABLE: manifests, staged receipt JSONs, commit candidates, analysis note, self-eval

TASK_ACK.note: Dispatch brief, standing brief, roles/scientist.md and the selection file read before the first paper.

TASK_CLAIM.claim_precondition_checked: H1/H2 lot disjoint from H3 (scientist-b) and H5 (scientist-d) lots by the selection file.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN: Xu ferroptosis review (H1 tier 1) not re-read: already read in full the same day by scientist-c (manifest and staged receipt on main); duplicate-work gate. The lot is therefore 29 papers plus one extra.

Extra self-chosen WWOX-direct reading: the Hong 2009 WWOX-C1q paper, found by registry theme search (not in the selection file; registry record stale, ledger holds a partial receipt); resumed with reread_reason inadequate_prior_coverage and the prior receipt named.
Commit gate refused stale derived surfaces on every commit; used LEGEND_STALE_SURFACES_BECAUSE with the reason that shared derived surfaces belong to the Orchestrator (dispatch brief).

Declared five receipts at partial depth (Porras, Chock, Jeong, Pinzon-Hoyos, Jiang) where supplementary panels or the protocol were not opened, rather than claim complete depth; other unopened supplement images (one Garcia-Delgado figure, Porras TIFFs) declared in their manifests.

Reference lists of all papers were term-screened for WWOX and not read item by item; gene-direct reference debts were resolved or queued per manifest, and the queued ones remain unqueued in the full-text queue (Orchestrator).

Staged receipts carry event_at equal to analysis_at as a placeholder so staged_receipt_check passes; the authoritative writer restamps it on recording. Receipts were not recorded and the ledger was not touched.
The DL-MECH-012 op was left alone, as instructed.
No commit-gate bypass beyond LEGEND_STALE_SURFACES_BECAUSE; no sandbox-bypass flag; no push.
Backed off and retried PubMed efetch/esearch after HTTP 500 and rate-limit failures; builders kept in a private scratch subdirectory.
After the session rate limit the work resumed from the committed milestone; five tier-3 plasma papers and one tier-2 paper were read in the resumed session.
Merged main into the task branch before landing (main had advanced by 132 commits; merge was clean).

Shipped micro-upgrade framework/scripts/docx_to_text.py with test, README routing row and release-regression enrolment, because a missed embedded-image supplement showed the throwaway reader printed text only.

A reviewer re-analysis (conventional adjusted regression on the shared patient file of one paper) and recomputations of published counts were done as checks and are labelled as not the authors' method; nothing was proposed as a correction to the literature.

WAVE_1_RESULT.micro_upgrade: framework/scripts/docx_to_text.py plus test_docx_to_text.py, README routing row, release-regression enrolment
